{{Top|leg}}
The '''Red List''' was a list of outstanding debts owed by [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Captain/Legends|captains]]. It was maintained by [[Interstellar Collections Limited/Legends|Interstellar Collections Limited]], which regularly deployed [[Skip tracer/Legends|skip tracers]] to collect the debts. They collected either full payment or simply took the craft in question and auctioned it off.

In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] [[Odumin]], disguised as the skip tracer Spray, tried to take possession of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], as he noted that its captain [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] owed a debt to an engineering company, presumably for work done on the ''Falcon''.
